name: 3-T-TRIS
summary: 3-Thiotrisescaline (3-T-TRIS), also known as 3-thiotrescaline or as 3-ethylthio-4,5-diethoxyphenethylamine, is a chemical compound of the phenethylamine and scaline families related to mescaline. It is the analogue of trisescaline (TRIS; trescaline) in which the ethoxy group at the 3 position has been replaced with an ethylthio group.
